sara (partnerships): EdgeFlux just confirmed shipment of 12 dev units. ETA to our lab on Mon 03/09. They want NDA + sample benchmark set handed over the same day. Can we lock down who owns what? :shipping: 
eli (partner-eng): nice — thanks. we should split the 12 into 4 soak, 4 perf, 4 reserved for partner demos. oi @olivia can lab-confirm capacity?
tom - eng-runtime: I can take perf and soak config. Will need image + kernel bits from EdgeFlux. @eli do we have a contact to pull the boot images?
kevin (bench): Perf plan: run 3x latency profiles (1k, 2k, 4k) and throughput sweep at batch sizes [1,4,8]. Also run quantized vs fp16. Need the sample prompts and dataset (small subsets) by Friday. Minimal run script I can use: ```bash
./run_bench --model /mnt/model --seq 1024 --batch 4 --mode throughput --out results.json
```
maria (legal): I have the NDA draft. EdgeFlux asked for a one-way NDA with a 2-year confidentiality term. I pushed back on limiting our benchmark publication rights — they agreed to internal results only for the EAP. I'll attach the redline in a sec. Please don't share logs outside the team.
olivia (lab-ops): Lab has space for 12 units Monday. Need a shipping manifest + serials for rack prep. Also confirm network VLAN and IP range — we prefer to keep EAP on isolated VLAN. lab-dock-bot: Received shipping notice from courier: AWB 1Z999AA10123456789. Expected delivery 03/09 09:00-12:00. Sender: EdgeFlux Labs. Items: 12 units, 2 power bricks each.
eli (partner-eng): contact is jason@edgeflux.io — he will send images and a usb recovery image. Jason also wants a quick joint announcement once we validate baseline numbers (internal only). No public PR without signoff.
sara (partnerships): action items: 1) maria finalize NDA and share redline by EOD Thu; 2) eli get images + sample dataset from Jason by Fri; 3) olivia confirm VLAN + rack power; 4) tom + kevin prep bench scripts and a short checklist for the partner handover. Mark owners on the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/partners/edgeflux/eap-handbook (do not share externally).
tom - eng-runtime: I'll prep a dockerized harness and a minimal runbook. Rough plan: bring up model, run smoke (inference on 10 prompts), then perf sweep. Will post a gist for the runbook by Friday.
kevin (bench): I'll prepare a canonical prompt set (200 prompts) and a smaller smoke set (10 prompts) and a scoring spreadsheet. Also adding latency p50/p95/p99 capture.
maria (legal): NDA redline uploaded to the doc. Tag me in the doc comments for any phrasing changes.
olivia (lab-ops): VLAN confirmed: 10.42.77.0/24, NATed outbound, no public ingress. Rack power: dual PDUs, provisioned. Need serials list by tonight for labeling.
eli (partner-eng): Jason will also include a small test image with debugging SSH enabled (kv:edgeflux-debug-2026-03-05). He asked for a contact for on-call during unpacking — @tom can you be primary?
tom - eng-runtime: I can be on-call Mon morning. If anything hardware-y, cc @olivia.
sara (partnerships): great, thanks all. keeping this high-touch for the first 10 days of the EAP. quick heartbeat: please post final checklist updates in the doc and ping if shipments slip. :raised_hands:
